messages:
incident-bot: Pager: DED-POOL ALERT for customer=CobaltFin (vpc=cobaltfin-vpc-3). Node node-77 reported unclean shutdown + repeated ECC parity spikes. Auto-drain attempted but failed to complete (evacuation stuck at 60%). Paging oncall

oncall-miguel: acked. I'm on it - joining zoom.

sre-anni: quick triage: node-77 kernel log shows repeated AER/PCIe errors then a GPU watchdog reset. eviction-controller tried to migrate 11 pods, 7 succeeded, 4 stuck in "terminating" (virt-fs hang). KV cache still pinned for a few tenants.

eng-raj: noted. Those terminating tasks often block on fenced NVMe. Plan: 1) force drain node to unblock 2) remap affected tenants to fallback pool 3) spin replacement node. Want to avoid mass rollbacks.

sre-anni: agree. immediate actions I'm doing now: - hold scheduling to node-77 - kick eviction-controller with --force - start prefix cache eviction for tenants with pinned sessions

eng-raj: commands I'll run (heads-up):
```
# force drain and evict stuck tasks
redwoodctl nodes drain node-77 --force --timeout 120s
# migrate KV caches
redwoodctl cache flush --tenant cobaltfin-prod --prefix session/
```

hw-ops-lara: hardware note: node-77 reported BMC communication glitches prior to GPU ECC escalation. I'm coordinating with colo on a cold power cycle and BMC reprobe. If BMC doesn't respond we'll declare HW replacement. ETA for physical in-rack work: 18 mins.

support-jess: I'll open a thread with the CobaltFin account team and send a short customer-facing update (non-technical). Want wording reviewed before I send. Affected: cobaltfin-prod serving realtime inference, ~6% of requests have 5-10s degradation for the last 12m.

pm-maya: can we confirm any SLA blips? we need exact numbers for CS.

sre-anni: preliminary: 6.2% of requests routed to pool impacted, p95 latency up from 92ms to 1.1s for those routes. Global ingress fallback to hosted model kept successful completion rate ~99.98%. Will provide final numbers after drain completes.

solutions-lin: for customers on dedicated pools we usually auto-fallback to hosted mirrored model; confirm CobaltFin has fallback enabled?

support-jess: CobaltFin does have fallback configured for their payment-ctx route; customer ops asked us not to failover other routes without notice. I'll call ops lead after we have mitigation.

eng-raj: mitigation plan (short):
- finish forced eviction to free pinned resources (now)
- remap cobaltfin-prod routes from node-77 -> dedpool-02 (in same region) via routing-policy (5m rollout)
- if remap fails, shift offending routes to hosted fallback (controlled, per-route)
- hardware replacement: replace GPU board on node-77, reprovision, run soak tests

sre-anni: I've started the force-evict. Current log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T16:12:02Z] evict: pod cobaltfin-prod-224 terminating -> stuck (fs-sync)
[2026-03-15T16:12:15Z] eviction-controller: force-eviction issued
[2026-03-15T16:13:05Z] cache-evict: prefix session/ retained 12MB -> 0
[2026-03-15T16:14:20Z] node-77: kernel AER error persist
```

hw-ops-lara: BMC responded to reprobe, remote power cycle in progress. If kernel AER continues after reboot we will mark as hardware fail and start replacement.

oncall-miguel: FYI I'm putting a temporary throttle on cobaltfin-prod routes to reduce retry amplification while we move traffic.

support-jess: draft to customer ops (short): "We observed a node-level hardware event in your dedicated pool. We are evacuating the node and remapping traffic to preserve service. Some requests may see transient latency while we complete the remap. We'll provide a timeline in 20 minutes." approve?

pm-maya: good. please include p95 delta and note fallback policy if we need it.

sre-anni: eviction finished, all 11 pods evicted. remapping jobs queued. starting routing policy to move cobaltfin-prod (canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100%).

eng-raj: kicking routing rollout now:
```
redwoodctl routing apply --tenant cobaltfin --route payment-ctx --policy remap-dedpool-02 --canary 10,50,100
```

incident-bot: Routing job accepted (job-id rj-8821). Estimated completion 6 minutes.

support-jess: sending customer update now (ops notified). I'll loop back with details once remap done.

hw-ops-lara: node-77 came back after cycle but GPU ECC errors reappeared under synthetic load. Marking hardware replace. Physically pulling spare GPU card; replacement ETA 35m.

sre-anni: routing job rj-8821 succeeded. cobaltfin payment-ctx is at 100% on dedpool-02. Observed p95 for that route back to ~110ms. Overall incident impact: small window of elevated latency for a subset of routes, no request loss.

oncall-miguel: handing off to hw-ops for replacement and to eng-runtime to monitor for any regression. I'll clear pager once replacement complete and soak verifies.

eng-raj: post-mitigation tasks: - verify KV cache warmup for cobaltfin-prod on dedpool-02 - run smoke evals for quality - schedule follow-up RCA w/ customer and hw ops

support-jess: customer acknowledges, asked for follow-up call in 2 hours. I'll schedule.

pm-maya: file a brief incident note and tag for SLA review. We may need to consider proactive fleet rotation for older BMC nodes.

hw-ops-lara: created HW ticket HWT-4621, spare installed and node reprovision in progress. Will update when node-77 verified in staging.

eng-raj: reminder: add runbook tweak to force-evict timeout step, the default was too short for virt-fs hangs. I'll open PR after this.

sre-anni: thanks all. handing off to hw-ops and eng-runtime for verification. leaving thread open until replacement verified. :white_check_mark:
